999008199.text:
もうすぐケイウン国の港に到着するし、
これからの流れを最後におさらいしよう

localizations.en: We'll be arriving at Keiun's harbor soon, so let's go over the plan one more time.

999008199.text:
ケイウンからやって来た巡視船には、錬金術士として
交易品を持ってきたと説明して、入港許可をもらった

localizations.en: I told the patrol ship from Keiun that we're alchemists bringing trade goods, and they gave us permission to dock.

999008199.text:
はい、この船は本当に交易品も積んでますもんね。
錬金術で作った特製のものをたくさん

localizations.en: Right, this ship really is carrying trade goods too. Lots of special items made with alchemy.

999008199.text:
拙者と永遠はお尋ね者で顔が割れている故、
忍術で姿を消しておきまする

localizations.en: Since Towa and I are wanted and our faces are known, we'll use ninjutsu to remain hidden.

999008199.text:
同じような検問が、上陸後にも再度行われる。
基本国を閉ざしているのでね、厳重で申し訳ない

localizations.en: There'll be another checkpoint like this after we land. The country's basically closed off, so security is tight. Sorry about that.

999008199.text:
ケイウンの品物、人気だけど
数が少ないの、分かる気がする

localizations.en: Keiun goods are popular, but they're scarce. I can see why now.

999008199.text:
もしかしたら品薄も手伝って
余計人気が出てるのかも？

localizations.en: Maybe the limited supply is actually making them even more popular?

999008199.text: 珍しいものは余計に欲しくなるもんねー

localizations.en: People always want what's rare and hard to get.

999008199.text:
その気持ちはケイウンの人々も同じさ。
特に鏑矢はね。新しいものが大好きなんだ

localizations.en: The people of Keiun feel the same way. Especially Kaburaya—she absolutely loves new things.

999008199.text:
だから今回の交易品、錬金術士特製の品々には
必ず食いついてくる。幼馴染として断言するよ

localizations.en: So she'll definitely be interested in our trade goods - these special alchemical items. I can guarantee it as her childhood friend.

999008199.text:
そうしたら、お城に呼び出されるはずだから
その誘いに乗って鏑矢さんに謁見する……

localizations.en: Then we should get invited to the castle, and we'll accept that invitation to have an audience with Kaburaya...

999008199.text:
はい。そしてその傍らにはコウセンがいるでしょう。
そこを……

localizations.en: Yes. And Kosen will surely be at her side. That's when we...

999008199.text: 狩る？

そうしたいのは山々でございまするが、
刃傷沙汰を起こせば皆様方が城から逃げられぬでしょう

localizations.en: As much as I'd like to, if we start a fight, you'll all be trapped in the castle.

999008199.text:
それに、謁見時に武器は取り上げられてしまうはずさ。
まあ今回は面通し、取り入るきっかけ作りだよ

localizations.en: Besides, they'll confiscate our weapons during the audience anyway. This first meeting is just to get acquainted and establish a connection.

999008199.text:
案内人としての話術で、
錬金術の品物をしっかりアピールしてみせますわ

localizations.en: I'll use my skills as a Guide to really showcase our alchemical goods.

999008199.text: 他に何か気を付けることはありますか？

localizations.en: Is there anything else we should be careful about?

999008199.text:
畳のへりを踏まないとか細々なしきたりはあるけど
その辺りは外国の客人として、大目に見てくれるはずさ

localizations.en: There are little customs like not stepping on the edges of tatami mats, but as foreign guests, they'll be more forgiving.

999008199.text:
それよりも気を付けてほしいのは、
逆に鏑矢に取り込まれないようにってところだね

localizations.en: What you really need to watch out for is making sure Kaburaya doesn't win you over instead.

999008199.text: どういうことですか？

臣下の拙者が評すのも畏れ多いのですが、
鏑矢様は生まれながらにして人の上に立つお方

localizations.en: Though it pains this humble retainer to speak of my Lady this way, Kaburaya was born to lead others.

999008199.text:
実力があれば身分が低い者も用いる気持ちのいい性格。
その覇気みなぎる気質は人たらしと称されることも……

localizations.en: She has many admirable qualities, and promotes those with ability regardless of their station. Her charismatic spirit has even been called... dangerously charming.

999008199.text:
思考を凶暴化された今もその辺りは変わっていない。
操り人形のようになっていたら周りも異変に気付くしね

localizations.en: Even with her thoughts turned violent, that hasn't changed. If she'd become like a mindless puppet, people around her would have noticed something was wrong.

999008199.text:
なるほど、天性の人たらしか……
それなら、こっちはヤンネさんの大人の色気で対抗だ！

localizations.en: I see, a natural charmer... In that case, we'll counter with Janne's mature appeal!

999008199.text: んもう、どうしてそうなるのよ……

localizations.en: Oh honestly, why does it always come to that...

999008199.text: んー……なかなかいい勝負になるかも

localizations.en: Hmm... That might actually be a pretty even match.

999008199.text: 無礼千万っ！
いてっ！
きゃっ！？
鬼門さんのツッコミで船が！？　これも忍術……！？

localizations.en: Kimon's smack made the whole ship shake!? Is that ninjutsu too!?

999008199.text: せ、拙者の仕業ではございませぬ！
魔物よ！　あそこ、上がってきてる！

localizations.en: It's a monster! Look, it's coming up over there!

999008199.text: もう！　ケイウンもすぐそこだってのに！！

localizations.en: Oh, come on! We're practically at Keiun already!!
